chartType.composition: Compose Recharts with Zeron Chart. These examples share the chart installation, palette, tooltip and accessible data table.
chartType.dataKeyProp: Map the chart marks to the original numeric data field.
chartType.sourceDescription: Uses the existing DonutSummary also used in project-monitor-01; the data here illustrates assigned and unassigned totals.
chartType.configProp: Map stable series keys to labels and shared chart colors.
chartType.tableProp: Expose the original values in a keyboard-accessible table.
chartType.dataProp: Supply original values without aggregation, implicit zeroes or reordering.
chartType.valueProp: Pass the actual total; null means unknown. An omitted total is inferred only from complete non-negative values.
chartType.centerProp: Supply the center summary and its business meaning.
chartType.title: Donut chart
chartType.description: Show parts of a whole with a center summary and an explicit unassigned remainder.
chartType.guidance: This composition uses DonutSummary. An explicit total of 100 leaves the missing 8 on a neutral track in the second example. Legend percentages use that total, while the center shows the assigned amount. Unknown totals must remain unknown.
